question_text: Differentiate between the benefits received under the Contributory Pension Scheme (CPS) and the new Exit Benefit Scheme (EBS) for a retiring officer. • Answer: The Contributory Pension Scheme (CPS) is a co-funded retirement model where both the employer and employee contribute percentages of the monthly salary into a Retirement Savings Account (RSA); upon retirement, the officer accesses a calculated lump sum and regular monthly pension monthly payments managed by their PFA. • The new Exit Benefit Scheme (EBS) acts as an additional gratuity framework. It is a 100% employer-funded, one-off payment equivalent to one full year's total annual emoluments paid directly to the retiree upon exit, without altering or reducing their CPS entitlements.

Enumerate five (5) critical pieces of information that MDAs must compile and submit to PenCom for the processing of an officer's 2026 Exit Benefit. As directed by PenCom, the required documentation includes:
Retirement Savings Account (RSA) Personal Identification Number (PIN).
Full legal name and official date of enlistment/first appointment.
Date of retirement and final Grade Level/Step.
Gross salary data, Pension Fund Administrator (PFA) details, and salary bank account details.

As a Management Staff in an MDA, explain the primary policy objectives behind the introduction of the EBS by President Bola Tinubu's administration. • The objectives include: • Social Protection: Reintroducing a robust financial safety net (gratuity) to safeguard retirees against immediate post-service economic shocks. • Dignity in Retirement: Ensuring public servants retire with financial security after dedicating their productive years to national development. • Workforce Motivation: Building a highly motivated, performance-driven, and people-centered civil service by upgrading welfare architectures.

Managing the Federal Character Principle vs. Meritocracy • Scenario: Your MDA has three vacancies for the post of Deputy Director (GL 16). After the promotion examinations, the top four candidates are from the same geopolitical zone, while candidates from under-represented zones scored just below the cut-off mark. • Question: As the Director of Human Resources, write an administrative memo to the Accounting Officer explaining how the Federal Civil Service Commission balances the statutory Federal Character Principle with Merit-based Promotion Guidelines without compromising public service efficiency.
